Citation metrics of PubMed articles from NIH iCite

Source: R/pmICite.R
pmICite.Rd

It retrieves citation counts and field-normalised metrics from the NIH iCite service, built on the NIH Open Citation Collection. No API key is required.

Usage

pmICite(pmids, batch_size = 500)

Arguments

pmids

is a character or numeric vector of PubMed identifiers (PMIDs).

batch_size

is numeric. PMIDs per request, at most 1000. Default is 500.

Value

a data frame with one row per PMID requested, in the same order, and the columns:

pmidThe PMID.
doiThe DOI.
yearThe publication year.
citation_countThe number of citing articles.
citations_per_yearCitations per year since publication.
relative_citation_ratioCitations compared with those expected in the article's field (1 is the NIH-funded median).
nih_percentileThe percentile of the ratio among NIH-funded articles.
is_research_articleWhether iCite classes it as primary research.

A PMID unknown to iCite has NA in every other column.

Details

PubMed itself counts only the citing articles in PubMed Central, so its figures are usually much lower than those of iCite.

See also

pmEnrichCitations, pmCitedBy

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
pmICite(c("10171110", "25824007"))
}
